headline: An AI bot is reportedly keeping the online trolls who target security researcher Marcus Hutchins going in circles.
score_reason: Pool score 2 lowered by 1: the claim is unverified and rests on a single outlet.
importance_line: It points to AI being tried as a defence against online trolling, which matters to anyone who receives abusive messages; who built the bot, how it works and how well it works are not known.
summary: Cybernews reports that an AI bot is keeping the online trolls who target security researcher Marcus Hutchins going in circles.
